verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Unleash exposes an MCP server so external LLM coding assistants can manage feature flags (unleash-docs-7, unleash-probe-2), but there is no evidence of the reverse direction — Unleash itself acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. This axis is plausible for a platform like Unleash, so absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
